## MindMosaic Parent Workspace UI — Final Journey Implementation

Draft PR implementing the remaining Parent Workspace UI based on the 8 November Claude Design handoff (`mindmosaic-parent-journey.html` / `page-dcb81aee8d83`).

---

### 1. Inherited Dependencies
This isolated feature branch was branched from fresh `origin/dev` (`17d8be2f`) and cleanly incorporates required predecessor work without altering their source branches:
- **PR #106** (`cb7e1496`): Nav shell (`ParentShell`), bottom nav, and shared primitives (`MarksMeter`, `ClaimWithEvidence`, `ChildSwitcher`, state blocks).
- **PR #107** (`23a24e2d`, `f931d491`, `bdf0a752`): Family Overview ("This week") dashboard at `/parent`.
- **PR #105** (`8ad2226c`): Trace document `docs/plans/parent-journey-trace-2026-11.md`.
- **Workspace UI Implementation** (`2df241af`): Implemented all 7 scope areas across 27 files.
- **Qualified Action Safety** (`b5fd33e9`): Added amber `Preview Demonstration` badges to all simulated actions, replaced `TKT-84920` with `SAMPLE-PREVIEW-ONLY`, and ensured no unqualified success claims.
- **Preview Isolation Gate** (`fb461257`): Gated preview routes behind loopback-only `isParentPreviewEnabled()`, disabled writing marking button in preview, and wired pre-existing routes to execute `legacy-page.tsx` for real accounts.
- **Family Overview Preview Fallback** (`f2acafcc`): Added preview fallback for `/parent` when `PARENT_WORKSPACE_PREVIEW=1` and Supabase is unconfigured.

---

### 2. Plan Limit & Places Verification
- **Agreed Family Plan Limit:** Strictly **3 paid places** (`FAMILY_PLAN.maxChildren = 3` in `src/lib/billing/prices.ts`).
- **Preview Fixture Alignment:** In `src/features/parent-dashboard/fixtures.ts`, `PREVIEW_FAMILY_PLAN.maxPlaces = 3`, `PREVIEW_CHILDREN` contains 2 active children (Aisha, Kabir) and 1 paused child (Maya).
- **Rendered Meter:** The Children Hub and Account views consistently display **"2 of 3 used on your Family plan"** and **"1 place free"**.
- **No 4-Place References:** Verified across all fixtures and components. (Any mention of "4 places" in previous reporting was a transcription error; the code and UI have always enforced 3).

---

### 3. Redesigned Screen Architecture & Route Mapping

The implementation strictly separates fixture demonstrations from live authenticated accounts:

| Route | Mode | Preview Behaviour (`PARENT_WORKSPACE_PREVIEW=1`) | Authenticated / Production Behaviour |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/parent/setup` | **Preview-only** | Renders `ParentSetupWizard` (`b0`–`b4`) with step progress, PIN reveal, and simulated card creation. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). Real onboarding uses the existing setup flow. |
| `/parent` | **Dual-mode** | Renders `FamilyOverview` (`b5`–`b10`) with sample children (Aisha & Kabir) and amber preview banner. | Executes original PR #107 server page, querying real Supabase attempts via `loadParentDashboard()` and `getMySubscription()`. |
| `/parent/children` | **Dual-mode** | Renders redesigned `ChildrenHub` (`b10`, `b13`, `b14`) with paid places meter and preview children. | Executes `legacy-page.tsx`, rendering live `ChildrenManager` with authenticated parent child rows from Supabase. |
| `/parent/children/[childId]` | **Preview-only** | Renders `ChildProfileDetail` (`b11`, `b12`) with local PIN reset demo, place pause/restore, and ADR-012 deletion modal. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/progress` | **Preview-only** | Renders `ChildProgressView` (`b15`, `b18`, `b19`) with subject breakdowns and ClaimWithEvidence floor ($\ge 2$ papers, $\ge 8$ marks). | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/results/[id]` | **Preview-only** | Renders `AttemptResultDetail` (`b16`) with strand-level marks breakdown and timing. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/results/[id]/review` | **Preview-only** | Renders `AttemptAnswerReview` (`b17`) with question-by-question student vs expected answers and explanations. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/curriculum` | **Dual-mode** | Renders `ChildCurriculumView` (`b20`, `b22`) with curriculum standards and strand units. | Executes `legacy-page.tsx`, performing `requireParentChildAccess` check and loading child curriculum. |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/preview` | **Preview-only** | Renders `PracticePreviewView` (`b21`) with test mode banner and disabled Assign/Stretch proposal cards. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/children/[childId]/writing` | **Dual-mode** | Renders read-only writing practice history; **"Mark a paper response" button is explicitly disabled** to prevent writes. | Executes `legacy-page.tsx`, performing `requireParentChildAccess` and querying real `writing_attempts` from Supabase. |
| `/parent/account` | **Dual-mode** | Renders redesigned `ParentAccountView` (`b23`–`b26`) with plan details, email change demo, and ADR-012 deletion modal. | Executes `legacy-page.tsx`, displaying real guardian profile, Supabase session details, and live password reset. |
| `/parent/help` | **Dual-mode** | Renders redesigned `ParentHelpView` (`b27`, `b29`) with 6 curated topics and search input. | Executes `legacy-page.tsx`. |
| `/parent/help/[slug]` | **Preview-only** | Renders `HelpArticleDetail` (`b28`) for curated topics (e.g. forgotten PIN, marks-not-bands, data erasure). | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/parent/help/contact` | **Preview-only** | Renders `SupportContactForm` (`b28`, `b33`) with simulated submission and `SAMPLE-PREVIEW-ONLY` ticket reference. | Returns `404` (via `requireParentPreview()`). |
| `/billing` | **Authenticated / Legacy** | Accessible directly with return link `← Back to family overview` (`/parent`). | Serves the existing Stripe billing checkout and customer portal handoff. |

---

### 4. Non-Negotiable Honesty & Safety Compliance
- **Zero Real Writes in Preview:** Simulated forms (child creation, PIN reset, email change, deletion request, support contact) operate purely in local React state and carry amber `Preview Demonstration` banners. The writing marking action is explicitly disabled.
- **Evidence Floor (Decision P3):** Strand claims require $\ge 2$ finished papers and $\ge 8$ scored marks.
- **No Evaluative Performance Bands (Decision D-P4):** Evaluative labels ("Exceeding", "Strong", "Needs practice") and percentage bars are completely omitted from all parent views. Scores are reported strictly as marks earned out of marks available (`X of Y marks`).
- **No 30-Day Erasure Wording (Decision P11):** Speculative retention/deletion timeframes have been excised; deletion copy adheres to ADR-012 guardian-verified administrative erasure.
- **Proposed Policies Labelled Disabled:** Assign Practice (P9) and Stretch Content (P10) are drawn as disabled proposal cards with clear pedagogical rationales.

---

### 5. Verification Status

Checks executed on HEAD (`f2acafcc`):
- `npm run typecheck`: **PASS** (0 errors).
- `npm run lint`: **PASS** (0 errors, 1 pre-existing warning in bar-model).
- `npm test`: **PASS** (all parent unit/component test suites pass, including `parent-preview-mode.test.ts`, `parent-workspace-ui.test.tsx`, `parent-writing-page.test.tsx`, `parent-curriculum-explorer-page.test.tsx`, `parent-layout.test.tsx`).
- `npx next build --webpack`: **PASS** (clean production build of all routes).
- Local Playwright browser verification: **PASS** (opened and verified all 15 routes on `http://localhost:3009`).

**Outstanding Verification Suites (Kept in Draft):**
- `npm run test:rls`: **Outstanding** (requires running local Supabase Docker instance).
- `npm run test:e2e`: **Outstanding** (full Playwright E2E suite).
- `npm run test:e2e:auth`: **Outstanding** (requires seeded local Supabase auth environment).

Implements the remaining Parent Workspace frontend artboards from the 8 November handoff:
1. Welcome and family setup (b0-b4 at /parent/setup)
2. Children hub and child profile (b10-b14 at /parent/children and /parent/children/[childId])
3. Child progress, result detail, and answer review (b15-b19 at /parent/children/[childId]/progress, .../results/[id], and .../results/[id]/review)
4. Support learning, including child curriculum explorer and practice preview (b20-b22 at /parent/children/[childId]/curriculum, .../preview, and .../writing)
5. Account and preferences (b23-b26 at /parent/account)
6. Help Centre, article detail, and support contact states (b27-b29 at /parent/help, .../help/[slug], and .../help/contact)
7. Entry and return links to existing billing UI (/billing <-> /parent/account#billing)

Honesty & governance rules enforced:
- Strictly removed all unapproved 30-day retention/deletion references (ADR-012)
- Strictly omitted evaluative performance bands from parent views
- Evaluative claims require evidence floor (>= 2 finished papers, >= 8 marks)
- Per-child pause/restore uses existing archive operation
- Clear preview fixtures & deferred backend operation disclaimers

…real pages by default

The redesigned Children, Account, Help, Curriculum and Writing pages read sample
fixtures and replaced real (authenticated, write-capable) pages. That let fixture
data stand in for real families and removed real child management.

- Add preview-mode gate: PARENT_WORKSPACE_PREVIEW=1 AND Supabase not configured
  AND not Vercel AND loopback host. Otherwise off.
- Pre-existing routes (children, account, help, child curriculum, child writing)
  serve their original real pages by default (legacy-page.tsx = pre-change code).
- Fixture-only routes (setup, child profile, progress, results, review, preview,
  help article, help contact) return 404 unless preview is enabled.
- Preview Writing page disables marking; no fixture screen performs a write.
- Unit tests for the gate.
